findings.finding: The order storefront facade delegated its selected GraphQL closure directly to the private adapter, so GraphqlHttpError display text was retained in UiTransportError.graphql_error.
findings.resolution: Create a per-call owner context at the public consumer boundary and map only CheckoutCompletionTransportError::Graphql to static public envelopes.

findings.finding: Cart UUID and checkout idempotency-key validation execute inside the private adapter before the GraphQL request.
findings.resolution: Pass Validation and ServerFn variants through unchanged and leave the private adapter unmodified.

findings.finding: The client-side GraphQL path had no owner correlation event for failures.
findings.resolution: Generate a unique per-call correlation id and retain only tenant configuration, identifier lengths, and create-fulfillment policy in internal diagnostics.

preserved_behavior: checkout completion request and response DTOs
